title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：weed　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weed 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the grower ① pulled the weed that no buyer in the greenhouse would have described, and he said the pulling was the whole of the summer. The ② weed, meaning the plant itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a weed, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ weed in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ weed at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A weed, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grower said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the weed was the whole of the matter, meaning the neglect and not the plant. The ⑥ weed, meaning the neglect and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; weed, he said, is either something you pull or the only word that means both a plant and a neglect. He said the neglect is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ weed had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ weed of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of describing; weed, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ weed I remember is the plant described in the ledger, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ weed, my mother said in 1982, is the only plant that improves by being described; every weed, she said, is a neglect that has agreed to look like a plant. She said the neglect was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 杂草（指大棚里每一株旁边的那一株）
B. n. 杂草（指那株杂草本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：pull the weed 拔这一株杂草
D. n. 杂草（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 杂草之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的杂草之事）
F. n. 杂草（指收成账里写到、被描述的那一株）
G. n. 杂草、荒疏（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荒疏（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: pulled the weed that no buyer in the greenhouse would have described
The weed, meaning the plant itself and not the crate
the weed at the far shelf
the weed was the whole of the matter
the weed had become a line in a ledger
The weed of the whole thing
A weed, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: pull the weed 意为“拔这一株杂草”，1973 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯描述的一株杂草做了一遍。
weed 意为“杂草”，指那株杂草本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
weed 意为“杂草”，指大棚里每一株旁边的那一株，每一株旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
weed 意为“杂草”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
weed 意为“杂草、荒疏”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这株荒疏就是那件事的全部。
weed 意为“荒疏”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那株杂草，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
weed 意为“杂草”，指收成账里写到、被描述的那一株，到 1978 年这一株成了收成账里的一行。
weed 意为“杂草之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的杂草之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的描述。
weed 意为“杂草”，我记得的是收成账里描述过的那一株，1980 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一株。
weed 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，杂草是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的杂草。
